referenceStatus: Frozen provisional v0.2 key; project owner confirmed human checks of all 60 reviews on 2026-10-02; not an independently adjudicated ground truth

comparison.interpretation: Matched prompt-condition comparison on the same 60 records. Descriptive, not a repeatability estimate.

p1Repeatability.interpretation: Separately dispatched P1 passes on the same 60 records. Pairwise comparisons are descriptive.

p1Fresh1Fresh3.interpretation: Pairwise comparison across separately dispatched P1 passes; descriptive.

p1Fresh2Fresh3.interpretation: Pairwise comparison across separately dispatched P1 passes; descriptive.

cost.note: The token-price estimate is not a provider bill. The full-context hold is a reservation bound.

timing.note: Client elapsed seconds include connected-app operator handoff and do not measure pure inference latency.

metrics.nativeChoiceProbabilities: Scored as distributions separately from the provider confidence field.
metrics.vendorConfidence: Reported separately; no calibration meaning is assumed.
metrics.confidenceErrors: Both vendor confidence and probability assigned to the chosen label are shown for incorrect predictions at or above 0.8.
